Switzerland , [ d ] officially the Swiss Confederation , [ e ] is a landlocked country [ 15 ] located at the intersection of Central , Western , and Southern Europe . [ f ] [ g ] [ 18 ] It is bordered by Germany to the north, France to the west, Austria and Liechtenstein to the east, and Italy to the south. Switzerland is geographically divided among the Swiss Alps , the Swiss Plateau , and the Jura Mountains ; the Alps cover most of the country's territory, whereas the majority of its 9 million people are concentrated on the plateau, which hosts many of the largest cities and economic centres, including Zurich , Geneva , Basel , Bern , Lausanne , Winterthur , and Lucerne . [ 19 ]
